resources.string: A living pill around your camera. Notifications, music and charging pop out of it, the way they do on iPhone.
Island uses this permission only to draw the floating island at the top of the screen. It does not read, collect or share anything on your screen.
Can\'t turn on the accessibility service? On Android 13+ sideloaded apps are restricted. Open Settings › Apps › Island, tap ⋮ (top right), choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
